## Related issue

Fixes #

External substantive PRs need a linked issue first. Maintainer-authored small docs or
maintenance may skip that wait.

## Human scope approval

- [ ] A human approved this work before agent implementation
- [ ] Maintainer-authored small docs / maintenance (no prior issue required)

## Agent-authored work

- [ ] I (the PR author) own this change, including any agent-generated diffs
- [ ] This PR was not opened by an unattended agent as the GitHub author

## Summary

What changed and why.

## Type of change

- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] Feature / package change
- [ ] Breaking change
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Maintenance / refactor
- [ ] Marketplace pin / catalog change

## Shared checklist

- [ ] No secrets, tokens, or private paths
- [ ] Generated files were regenerated, not hand-edited
- [ ] Lockfiles / packed catalog outputs match source when this repo produces them
- [ ] User-visible change is recorded in CHANGELOG (or N/A)
- [ ] CONTRIBUTING local checks for this repo were run

## Repo extras

- [ ] Release metadata matches `apm.yml`
- [ ] APM source integrity / audit succeeds
- [ ] Consumer install checks were run if release-sensitive surfaces changed
- [ ] NOTICE still credits danielmeppiel/genesis (Apache-2.0)
- [ ] Frozen dependency graph / Atlas store validation ran if those surfaces changed
